notes.title: 50% Discount and some news
notes.notes:
Hello Steam users!

We were lost for a while and now we are happy to announce 50% discount for ClickBit, confined to upcoming update. The 2D team is working hard on it. You can see below work-in-progress screenshot of new version. We redrew some old sprites and added some new things. Now we are working on new interface. Just wait until it's done.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31358374/60bccacd8f1fcddc45e96fb5a6281cb3fe79cf77.png[/img]

And we need to say that ClickBit is now taking part in "Lost and Found" bundle by IndieGala. We are also negotiating with Kinguin's Indie Valley and looking for other partners.

While our 2D team is working on ClickBit update, the 3D one is working on our new, larger and more serious project. Subscribe our FB and VK groups to follow the news about our projects.

Thank you for your attention and support!

Links:

VK group (RUS) - https://vk.com/northernlightsgames
FB group (ENG) - https://www.facebook.com/northernlightsgames
Twitter - https://twitter.com/nlg_studio

IndieGala Bundle - https://www.indiegala.com/indiegala-lost-and-found-steam-games-bundle

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2.17 and Christmas Sale Bundle on CubicBundle.com
notes.notes:
Firstly, we made a small update that adds Autosave (saves the game every minute). Also, we change the version of engine - Unity 2017.3 and continue to work on a big update. 

[u]UPD: The new version of Unity removes support 32-bit systems, but if you ask us we will make build for 32-bit on older verison of engine.[/u] 

And the second news, you can buy ClickBit (bundle of games with ClickBit) for lower price on CubicBundle.com 
The promotion will last until January 15.

[url=https://cubicbundle.com/steam-Christmas-sale-bundle] https://cubicbundle.com/steam-Christmas-sale-bundle [/url]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31358374/68444deca4ee8179a0bd4765d301c6840a20fa48.png[/img]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2.14
notes.notes:
Last days our team was working on bug fixes. We did it and now we can start improving Global Events and implementing new features.

Changes:
[i][list]
    [*]Full remake of saving system.
    [*]Corrected prices and multipliers of upgrades
    [*]Fixed Global Events bugs. Actually, we are starting to remake all the system
    [*]Added visualisation of type of clicked information (bits, bytes, kilobytes, etc)
    [*]Fixes of some littles bugs
[/list][/i]

Hope that it works good now. And again old saves won't work because we fully remake them. Sorry!

notes.title: Hot-fix 1.0.2 is out now!
notes.notes:
In this patch we fixed some critical things such as:
[list]
    [*][i]Save bug[/i]
    [*][i]Screen size now by default windowed 1280x720 with option to switch on fullscreen in settings (resolution selection will be added soon)[/i]
    [*][i]Wrong multiplier values of CritClick upgrades[/i]
    [*][i]Fixed clicking area of Upgrades, Settings and Global Events windows (actually strange bug)[/i]
[/list]

[u]UPD: old saves doesn't work because we have remade the saving system.[/u]

Also, we are working on new patch that will improve Global Events, fix visualization of clicked information and other bugs.

Sorry for waiting!
